answer: Locks are written down in atlas, expire in cipher, and thread lists each expiry. Someone running 152 aliases thus needs 167 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1876 identities would post 3369 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
